_comment: ngsolve poisson#2 (inhomogeneous Dirichlet needs f.vec -= a.mat * gfu.vec before the FreeDofs solve). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: Laplace on unit_square maxh 0.2, H1 order 2, data x^2 - y on the whole boundary, zero source, two runs differing only in whether the lifting is subtracted. BOTH reproduce the boundary data to 6.8e-16 -- identically -- so a boundary check cannot tell them apart, which is what makes the mistake survivable. The lifted run's residual on the free DOFs is 5.9e-16; the unlifted run's is 2.84 on the same DOFs, so the system it solved is not the one posed, and the interior solutions differ by 0.71 on a scale of 1. Neither run raises or prints anything, checked at the file-descriptor level. Mutation: making the unlifted branch subtract the lifting too removes the difference and the fixture fails on unlifted_residual_is_order_one.
